metadata.description: 100 case studies organized by 10 global zones, grouped by Hofstede cultural/economic similarity
metadata.verification_note: Case studies from Claude training data are based on well-documented organizations. Impact numbers are approximate and should be verified before use in formal publications.

east_asia.hofstede_summary: High MAS, High UAI, High LTO, Medium IDV

case_studies.title: KATARIBA: Diagonal Relationships That Save Japanese Youth
case_studies.problem: Japanese teens have among lowest self-esteem globally; widening opportunity gap
case_studies.model: Four pillars: DISCOVER, RESILIENCE, GLOCAL, POST-TRAUMATIC GROWTH. Uses 'diagonal relationships' — older peers, not parents/teachers.
case_studies.impact: 98,935 high school students; 157 staff; 7 locations; Time Magazine cover (2009); Prime Minister's Commendation (2016)
case_studies.what_worked: Diagonal relationships create unique trust; four-pillar model addresses different needs
case_studies.what_didnt: Scaling beyond Japan; funding dependent on donations
case_studies.key_lesson: Don't fight the system. Build alongside it.

case_studies.title: ETIC.: Japan's Social Entrepreneur Ecosystem
case_studies.problem: Japan lacked infrastructure for social entrepreneurs
case_studies.model: Ecosystem builder: MAKERS UNIVERSITY, Tokyo Startup Gateway, Social Entrepreneurship School, DRIVE Career, Local Venture Lab.
case_studies.impact: 2,000+ entrepreneurs supported since 1993; 30+ years active; disaster recovery in 80 regions
case_studies.what_worked: Ecosystem approach — pipeline from idea to scale; created Japan's first long-term internship (1997)
case_studies.what_didnt: Dependent on grants; Japanese startup culture lags US/Europe
case_studies.key_lesson: Don't build one startup — build the infrastructure for 1,000 startups.

case_studies.title: Civic Force: 24-Hour Disaster Response
case_studies.problem: Japan's disasters lack coordinated private-sector + NPO rapid-response
case_studies.model: Coordination body deploying helicopters and teams within 24 hours. Bridges companies, NGOs, government.
case_studies.impact: Responded to every major Japan disaster since 2011; raised 300M yen in 3 days (2011 earthquake)
case_studies.what_worked: 24-hour deployment — speed is the product; public-private partnership model
case_studies.what_didnt: Japan-focused; dependence on corporate donations
case_studies.key_lesson: Be the coordinator, not the executor. The connector is the most valuable player.

case_studies.title: Silver Human Resource Centers
case_studies.problem: Japan's aging population needs meaningful employment and social connection
case_studies.model: Government-supported membership organizations offering light work for seniors 60+. Focus on confidence-building and social connection.
case_studies.impact: Centers exist in every municipality in Japan; legal framework requiring re-employment until 65
case_studies.what_worked: Government-backed — sustainable; focus on social connection, not just income
case_studies.what_didnt: Matching seniors with skilled positions difficult; systemic ageism
case_studies.key_lesson: The problem isn't just money — it's meaning. Address the emotional need.

case_studies.title: Peace Boat: 60,000+ Participants for Peace
case_studies.problem: Promoting peace, human rights, sustainability through experiential education
case_studies.model: Global voyages combining travel with peace-building workshops and SDG education.
case_studies.impact: 95+ global voyages; 60,000+ participants; Nobel Peace Prize nomination (2008); UN Special Consultative Status
case_studies.what_worked: Experiential education — learning by visiting
case_studies.what_didnt: Limited to those who can travel; expensive per participant
case_studies.key_lesson: Experiential education creates lasting change. Visit the problem, don't just read about it.

case_studies.title: Ashinaga: 8,000+ Orphaned Students Supported Annually
case_studies.problem: Orphaned children worldwide lack financial and emotional support for higher education
case_studies.model: Scholarships, mentorship, emotional care for orphaned students. Ashinaga Africa Initiative sends students to universities globally.
case_studies.impact: 8,000+ orphaned students supported annually; operations in Japan, UK, Uganda, Senegal
case_studies.what_worked: Funded entirely by donations — no government subsidies; global reach
case_studies.what_didnt: Scale limited by donation base
case_studies.key_lesson: Emotional care is as important as financial support. Don't just fund — mentor.

case_studies.title: Teach For Japan
case_studies.problem: Severe teacher shortage; Japan's education investment among lowest in OECD
case_studies.model: Fellowship placing non-traditional candidates as teachers in underserved schools.
case_studies.impact: 57,000+ children impacted; fellows in 31 of 47 prefectures; 90% alumni pursue education careers
case_studies.what_worked: Cross-sector recruitment brought fresh energy
case_studies.what_didnt: Fellows leave after commitment period
case_studies.key_lesson: The best teachers aren't always trained teachers. Cross-sector recruitment brings fresh perspectives.

case_studies.title: LIFULL: Social Impact Through Housing
case_studies.problem: Japan's declining population creates vacant houses and aging communities need revitalization
case_studies.model: Publicly traded company operating Japan's largest housing database, combined with social impact initiatives: LIFULL Regional Revitalization, LIFULL SOCIAL SHIFT.
case_studies.impact: Revenue: 36.4 billion yen (~$270M); operates in 60 countries; 1,696 employees
case_studies.what_worked: Integrating social impact into for-profit housing platform
case_studies.what_didnt: Balancing profit and impact
case_studies.key_lesson: A for-profit company can drive social impact. Housing is a platform for community revitalization.

case_studies.title: JOICFP: Parasite Control + Family Planning
case_studies.problem: 800 women die daily from pregnancy/childbirth in developing countries
case_studies.model: Integrated family planning with community health. Pioneered combining parasite control with family planning. Trains local health volunteers.
case_studies.impact: Trained 5,600+ health personnel across 87 countries; UN Population Award recipient
case_studies.what_worked: Combining parasite control with family planning — unique Japanese innovation
case_studies.what_didnt: Sustaining skills after projects end
case_studies.key_lesson: Sometimes the innovation is combining two things nobody thought to combine.

case_studies.title: Minna no Kai: 50-Year Community Elder Care
case_studies.problem: Japan's elderly live alone. Traditional care systems breaking down.
case_studies.model: Neighbors checking on neighbors. Volunteer drivers. Shared meals. Community salons ($200/month). Pioneered Japan's national community-based integrated care system.
case_studies.impact: 50+ years of operation; pioneered Japan's national policy
case_studies.what_worked: Social obligation (amae) and neighborhood bonds; structured daily check-ins; low-cost salons
case_studies.what_didnt: Urban areas lack community bonds; aging volunteers
case_studies.key_lesson: The solution is already there — it's called 'being a neighbor.' Formalize the informal.

case_studies.title: Ant Forest: 600M Users Planting 326M Real Trees
case_studies.problem: Desertification in Northwest China; individuals had no way to contribute to reforestation
case_studies.model: Gamified green behavior — users earn points for low-carbon actions (walking, public transit). Points grow virtual trees that Ant Group plants in reality.
case_studies.impact: 600M+ users; 326M+ real trees planted across 112,000+ hectares; UN 'Champions of the Earth' 2019
case_studies.what_worked: Brilliant behavioral design — made climate action personal and social
case_studies.what_didnt: Critics question carbon offset calculations; some planted areas face survival challenges
case_studies.key_lesson: Gamification turns passive users into active participants. Make the right action the easy action.

case_studies.title: Tencent 99 Giving Day: $4B+ Channeled Through WeChat
case_studies.problem: China's individual donation rate was extremely low
case_studies.model: 99 Giving Day — China's largest annual online giving event. Tencent matches donations, uses WeChat's social graph to gamify giving.
case_studies.impact: 1.5B+ donations facilitated; $4B+ channeled; 120M+ participants across 8 years
case_studies.what_worked: Leveraged WeChat's 1B+ user base; made giving social and competitive
case_studies.what_didnt: Criticism of 'performative philanthropy'; smaller NGOs struggle to compete
case_studies.key_lesson: When giving is social, giving scales. Use the social graph, not just the donation button.

case_studies.title: One Foundation: One Person, One Yuan, One Month
case_studies.problem: Disaster relief infrastructure in China was fragmented; limited individual philanthropy
case_studies.model: Mass micro-donations for disaster relief, children's welfare, philanthropy ecosystem building.
case_studies.impact: 9.87B person-times donation support; RMB 4B+ in expenditures; responded to Sichuan earthquake
case_studies.what_worked: Celebrity founder drove awareness; pioneered independent charitable fundraising in China
case_studies.what_didnt: Early Red Cross affiliation credibility crises; Jet Li's reduced public presence
case_studies.key_lesson: Celebrity credibility opens doors, but the system must survive without the celebrity.

case_studies.title: Project Hope: 18,085 Schools Built for Rural Children
case_studies.problem: Millions of rural children unable to attend school due to poverty
case_studies.model: Individual donor sponsors a specific child's education. Funds build Hope Primary Schools in rural areas.
case_studies.impact: RMB 9.13B raised; 18,085 Hope Primary Schools built; 4.6M+ students aided
case_studies.what_worked: Emotional donor-to-child connection; iconic 'Big Eyes' photograph; aligned with government priorities
case_studies.what_didnt: Fund mismanagement scandals (2011); model criticized for paternalism; some schools fell into disuse
case_studies.key_lesson: One photograph can change a nation. The 'Big Eyes' girl became China's most powerful charity image.

case_studies.title: China Foundation for Rural Development: 33M Aid Cases
case_studies.problem: Rural poverty, maternal/child health, education in poorest provinces
case_studies.model: Multi-program: healthcare, nutrition, education, disaster relief. Internet fundraising via Alibaba.
case_studies.impact: RMB 34B+ raised; 33M+ individual aid cases; one of China's largest foundations
case_studies.what_worked: Government partnership for credibility; Alibaba platform integration for massive fundraising
case_studies.what_didnt: State-initiated origins create governance questions; independence concerns
case_studies.key_lesson: Platform integration is the force multiplier. Alibaba turned a foundation into a movement.

southeast_asia.hofstede_summary: High PDI (64-94), Low-Medium IDV (14-39), Medium MAS, Low-Medium UAI

case_studies.title: Gawad Kalinga: 70,000+ Homes Built by Communities
case_studies.problem: Millions of Filipino families live in unsafe informal settlements
case_studies.model: Community-driven housing: corporations, volunteers, and families co-build villages. Each village includes housing, education, health, livelihood.
case_studies.impact: 70,000-200,000+ homes built; 2,000-3,000 communities; Haiyan response: 2,923 new homes
case_studies.what_worked: Corporate partnership model (Ayala, SM, Jollibee); holistic approach
case_studies.what_didnt: Scale vs. quality tension; dependency on corporate donors
case_studies.key_lesson: Housing alone isn't enough. A home without education, health, and livelihood is just a building.

case_studies.title: Teach for the Philippines
case_studies.problem: Filipino students face severe learning gaps. Many graduate functionally illiterate.
case_studies.model: Recruit professionals from diverse fields to teach in underserved public schools for 2 years.
case_studies.impact: Hundreds of fellows deployed; 50%+ remain in education after fellowship
case_studies.what_worked: Cross-sector recruitment brought fresh talent; alumni network became policy pipeline
case_studies.what_didnt: Small scale vs. national teacher shortage; high dropout during fellowship
case_studies.key_lesson: The best teachers aren't always trained teachers. Cross-sector recruitment brings fresh energy.

case_studies.title: Rags2Riches: Turning Trash Into Premium Fashion
case_studies.problem: Women in Payatas dumpsite earn below minimum wage from scrap materials
case_studies.model: Social enterprise upcycling scrap cloth into premium fashion accessories. Fair wages, training, design support.
case_studies.impact: Hundreds of artisan women empowered; National Geographic featured; Ashoka Fellow
case_studies.what_worked: Premium positioning transformed 'trash' into aspirational products
case_studies.what_didnt: Scaling artisan production while maintaining quality
case_studies.key_lesson: Position determines price. The same scrap cloth, positioned as premium, pays living wages.

case_studies.title: Liter of Light: Solar Lighting for 382,000+ Filipinos
case_studies.problem: Millions lack access to electricity in off-grid and disaster-affected communities
case_studies.model: Grassroots movement teaching communities to build solar lighting from local materials.
case_studies.impact: 382,000+ Filipinos helped; operates in 32 countries; cut crime 70% in Tacloban
case_studies.what_worked: Ultra-low-cost technology; community training model ensures sustainability
case_studies.what_didnt: Bottle lamps have limited lifespan; scaling to complex systems needed engineering
case_studies.key_lesson: Teach them to build it themselves. A community that can make its own lights doesn't need you anymore.

case_studies.title: Hapinoy: Empowering 800,000 Corner Stores
case_studies.problem: 800,000+ sari-sari stores lack business skills, financing, supply chain
case_studies.model: Micro-enterprise development: training, aggregation, digitization of corner store owners.
case_studies.impact: Thousands of micro-entrepreneurs reached; Ashoka Fellow
case_studies.what_worked: Trusted store owners as community distribution points; low-cost, high-reach model
case_studies.what_didnt: Digitization adoption slower than expected
case_studies.key_lesson: The corner store is the community hub. Empower the store owner, empower the neighborhood.

case_studies.title: Human Nature: Natural Products, Living Wages
case_studies.problem: Filipino communities lack affordable natural products; rural workers lack dignified employment
case_studies.model: Social enterprise selling 100% natural personal care products. Living wages, local sourcing, profits reinvested.
case_studies.impact: Hundreds of employees with living wages; products in thousands of outlets; competing with multinationals
case_studies.what_worked: Proved social enterprise can compete with multinational brands on shelf
case_studies.what_didnt: Higher price point limits reach to lower-income consumers
case_studies.key_lesson: Ethical business can compete with multinational corporations. Values-driven consumers exist.

case_studies.title: Gojek: Super-App for Indonesia's Informal Economy
case_studies.problem: Indonesia's informal workers (motorcycle taxis, food vendors) lack digital infrastructure
case_studies.model: Super-app connecting motorcycle taxi drivers, food delivery, payments, and services.
case_studies.impact: Millions of drivers; $10B+ valuation; transformed Indonesia's informal economy
case_studies.what_worked: Digitized existing informal services (ojek motorcycle taxis); created massive employment
case_studies.what_didnt: Driver welfare concerns; regulatory challenges
case_studies.key_lesson: Don't create new behavior — digitize existing behavior. The ojek already existed. Gojek just gave it an app.

case_studies.title: Kopernik: Last-Mile Technology Distribution
case_studies.problem: Rural communities in Indonesia lack access to simple, life-improving technologies
case_studies.model: Distributes proven technologies (solar lights, water filters, clean cookstoves) through local networks in remote areas.
case_studies.impact: Hundreds of thousands of people reached across Indonesia; technology distribution in remote islands
case_studies.what_worked: Local distribution networks; technology that's already proven (not experimental)
case_studies.what_didnt: Logistics in remote islands; technology maintenance
case_studies.key_lesson: The technology exists. The problem is distribution. Solve the last mile.

case_studies.title: Grab for Good: Southeast Asia's Super-App Impact
case_studies.problem: Southeast Asia's informal workers lack digital infrastructure and financial access
case_studies.model: Super-app for ride-hailing, food delivery, payments. Grab for Good program for driver welfare and financial inclusion.
case_studies.impact: Millions of driver-partners across 8 countries; financial services for unbanked; COVID economic support
case_studies.what_worked: Platform created millions of income opportunities; financial services for previously unbanked
case_studies.what_didnt: Gig worker welfare concerns; regulatory challenges across markets
case_studies.key_lesson: A platform can be a social impact tool. Millions of driver-partners = millions of income opportunities.

case_studies.title: Teach For Vietnam
case_studies.problem: Vietnamese students in rural areas face quality education gaps
case_studies.model: Fellowship program placing talented graduates in underserved schools. Part of Teach For All network.
case_studies.impact: Hundreds of fellows placed; part of global Teach For All network
case_studies.what_worked: Adapted Teach For All model to Vietnamese context; government partnerships
case_studies.what_didnt: Scale limited by funding; retention after fellowship
case_studies.key_lesson: Global models work when adapted to local context. Don't copy — adapt.

south_asia.hofstede_summary: High PDI (70-80), Low IDV (14-48), Medium MAS, Low IVR/Restrained (20-26)

case_studies.title: BRAC: 100M+ People Reached
case_studies.problem: Extreme poverty in post-war Bangladesh
case_studies.model: Graduation approach: microfinance + health + education. Partly self-funded via social enterprises (Aarong retail, dairy). 100,000+ Shasthya Shebika community health volunteers.
case_studies.impact: 100M+ people reached across 11 countries; 95% still improving 7 years later (RCT)
case_studies.what_worked: Local women as volunteers; weekly coaching; asset transfer; 24-month program
case_studies.what_didnt: High cost per household ($500/24mo); donor dependency crisis (2025)
case_studies.key_lesson: The human element — a neighbor who shows up every week — is the irreplaceable ingredient.

case_studies.title: Grameen Bank: Microloans for 9M Borrowers
case_studies.problem: Poor people excluded from banking
case_studies.model: Group lending with social collateral. 5-person groups, peer accountability. 97% repayment. 97% women.
case_studies.impact: $10B+ loaned to 9M borrowers; Nobel Peace Prize 2006
case_studies.what_worked: Group accountability; women-focused; local loan officers
case_studies.what_didnt: Credit alone doesn't lift people out of poverty; some debt cycles
case_studies.key_lesson: Credit alone is not enough. It helps with smoothing and resilience, but without training and coaching, it doesn't lift people out of poverty.

case_studies.title: ASHA Workers: 1 Million Women Walking Door to Door
case_studies.problem: Rural India has clinics but no connection between clinics and villages
case_studies.model: One million+ women, one per ~1,000 population. Local woman connects village to health system. Incentive-based pay.
case_studies.impact: 1,000,000+ ASHAs; central to India's COVID response
case_studies.what_worked: She is from the village, speaks the language, knows every family; incentive-based pay
case_studies.what_didnt: 92% report excessive workload; 70% face payment delays
case_studies.key_lesson: A woman from the village who speaks the language is more effective than any outside expert.

case_studies.title: CLTS: Making Communities Disgusted With Themselves
case_studies.problem: 394 million people practice open defecation
case_studies.model: Facilitator triggers collective disgust. Community builds own latrines. No subsidies.
case_studies.impact: Adopted in 60+ countries; open defecation decreased in all evaluations
case_studies.what_worked: No subsidy — community invests own resources; shame + pride as behavior change
case_studies.what_didnt: Shame can be harmful if not managed; doesn't work in all contexts
case_studies.key_lesson: When the community decides together, behavior change sticks. Don't build for them. Trigger them to build.

case_studies.title: Akshaya Patra: School Lunch for 2 Million Children
case_studies.problem: Hungry children can't learn; school attendance drops without food
case_studies.model: Centralized kitchen model producing nutritious school lunches at scale. Technology-driven logistics.
case_studies.impact: 2M+ children fed daily across 12 states; world's largest NGO school lunch program
case_studies.what_worked: Centralized kitchens achieve massive scale and cost efficiency; technology-driven logistics
case_studies.what_didnt: Menu variation challenges; supply chain in remote areas
case_studies.key_lesson: Scale requires systems, not just will. Centralized kitchens + technology = feeding 2 million children daily.

case_studies.title: Barefoot College: Grandmothers as Solar Engineers
case_studies.problem: Rural communities lack electricity and education; trained professionals won't stay in villages
case_studies.model: Train illiterate grandmothers as solar engineers. 6-month training. They return and electrify their villages.
case_studies.impact: Thousands of grandmothers trained; villages electrified across 96 countries
case_studies.what_worked: Training grandmothers (not young men who leave); they stay and serve their communities
case_studies.what_didnt: 6-month training away from family; technology maintenance challenges
case_studies.key_lesson: The people most likely to stay are the people with roots. Train grandmothers, not graduates.

case_studies.title: Gram Vikas: Water and Sanitation for 100,000+ Households
case_studies.problem: Rural India lacks clean water and sanitation; open defecation widespread
case_studies.model: Community-led water and sanitation. 100% household coverage required before project starts. Everyone included.
case_studies.impact: 100,000+ households with water and sanitation across Odisha
case_studies.what_worked: 100% inclusion requirement ensures no one left behind; community ownership
case_studies.what_didnt: Slow to scale; requires deep community engagement
case_studies.key_lesson: 100% inclusion is harder but more sustainable. When everyone has water, everyone maintains the system.

case_studies.title: Kashf Foundation: Microfinance for Pakistani Women
case_studies.problem: Pakistani women excluded from financial services
case_studies.model: Microfinance + financial literacy + enterprise development for women. Group lending model.
case_studies.impact: Hundreds of thousands of women clients; high repayment rates; expanded to education and health
case_studies.what_worked: Women-only groups create safe space; financial literacy alongside loans
case_studies.what_didnt: Cultural resistance in conservative areas; scaling in rural Pakistan
case_studies.key_lesson: Women-only spaces create safety. When women lend to women, repayment rates soar.

case_studies.title: Teach For India
case_studies.problem: India's education system fails millions of children in low-income communities
case_studies.model: Fellowship placing talented graduates in underserved schools for 2 years. Part of Teach For All network.
case_studies.impact: Thousands of fellows placed across multiple cities; alumni in education policy and leadership
case_studies.what_worked: Cross-sector recruitment; alumni network driving systemic change
case_studies.what_didnt: Scale vs. India's massive education needs; retention challenges
case_studies.key_lesson: Two years in a classroom changes the fellow as much as the students. Both become advocates for change.

case_studies.title: Shapla Neer: 50+ Years in Bangladesh
case_studies.problem: Poverty in Bangladesh and Nepal; child labour; disaster vulnerability
case_studies.model: Citizen-led NGO working in close dialogue with local communities. Child labour reduction, girls' support, disaster preparedness, fair trade.
case_studies.impact: 50+ years continuous operation across 3 countries; lean team (27 staff total)
case_studies.what_worked: Close dialogue with communities; lean operations; long-term presence
case_studies.what_didnt: Small scale; funding dependent on donations
case_studies.key_lesson: 50 years of continuous presence builds trust that no new organization can replicate.

case_studies.title: Aravind Eye Care: 10.8M Surgeries, 70% Free
case_studies.problem: Needless blindness affecting millions who couldn't afford surgery
case_studies.model: Cross-subsidy — paying patients fund free surgeries for the poor. Assembly-line efficiency (100+ surgeries/day per surgeon).
case_studies.impact: 90M+ outpatient visits; 10.8M+ surgeries; 60-70% treated free; 14 hospitals; WHO/WEF recognized
case_studies.what_worked: McDonald's-inspired operational efficiency; Aurolab producing lenses at 1/100th cost
case_studies.what_didnt: Slow to digitize initially; limited geographic spread beyond Tamil Nadu
case_studies.key_lesson: The McDonald's model works for surgery. Assembly-line efficiency + cross-subsidy = 10.8M surgeries, 70% free.

case_studies.title: Jaipur Foot: $45 Prosthetics for 1.45M Amputees
case_studies.problem: Amputees in developing countries couldn't afford prosthetics ($12,000+ in West)
case_studies.model: Free prosthetic limb fitting using locally-developed Jaipur Foot ($45 vs. $12,000 Western). Culturally appropriate (barefoot-friendly, squatting-compatible).
case_studies.impact: 1.45M+ amputees fitted worldwide; 16,000+ fittings/year; operations in 27+ countries; HBS case study
case_studies.what_worked: Culturally appropriate design; zero-cost model removes all barriers
case_studies.what_didnt: Durability concerns vs. Western prosthetics; limited R&D until recent partnerships
case_studies.key_lesson: Design for the user's life, not the engineer's specs. The Jaipur Foot works because amputees can squat, walk barefoot, and farm.

case_studies.title: Goonj: Cloth for Work — 2,000+ Tons Annually
case_studies.problem: Urban waste cloth discarded while rural poor lacked basic clothing
case_studies.model: 'Cloth for Work' — communities earn urban surplus materials by completing local infrastructure projects (roads, wells, bridges).
case_studies.impact: 2,000+ tons of material channeled annually across 21 states; Ramon Magsaysay Award 2015
case_studies.what_worked: Dignity-first approach (no charity, earned through work); massive urban-to-rural pipeline
case_studies.what_didnt: Quality control of donated items; scaling logistics across diverse states
case_studies.key_lesson: Dignity is the product. When people EARN what they receive, they value it. When they're given charity, they don't.

case_studies.title: Pratham: 34M Children Taught to Read
case_studies.problem: India's learning crisis — children in school but not learning to read
case_studies.model: 'Teaching at the Right Level' (TaRL) — simple, scalable remedial education by community volunteers. ASER surveys 600,000+ children annually.
case_studies.impact: 34M+ children reached; ASER used by 600+ organizations; TaRL adopted by 15+ countries; J-PAL validated
case_studies.what_worked: Evidence-based (J-PAL validated); government partnerships for scale; ASER became India's learning metric
case_studies.what_didnt: Volunteer retention; sustainability dependent on government adoption
case_studies.key_lesson: Simple works. TaRL is just 'teach kids at their level, not their grade.' J-PAL proved it. 15 countries adopted it.

case_studies.title: Sulabh International: 1.5M Toilets, 60,000 Jobs
case_studies.problem: India's sanitation crisis — manual scavenging, open defecation, caste discrimination
case_studies.model: Two-pit pour-flush toilet (affordable, no sewage needed). 3,000+ community toilet complexes in 1,700+ towns.
case_studies.impact: 1.5M+ household toilets built; 60,000 workers employed; freed thousands from manual scavenging; UN-recognized
case_studies.what_worked: Simple, replicable technology; linked sanitation to caste dignity; revenue from pay-per-use toilets
case_studies.what_didnt: Pathak's death (2023) created leadership uncertainty; critics say model didn't address sewage infrastructure
case_studies.key_lesson: Sanitation is a dignity issue, not just a health issue. When you link toilets to caste justice, you change the conversation.

figures.impact: $10B+ loaned to 9M borrowers; pioneered microfinance

figures.name: Ela Bhatt

central_asia.hofstede_summary: High PDI (75-95), Low IDV (10-25), High MAS, High UAI

case_studies.title: Teach For Kazakhstan
case_studies.problem: Educational inequality in Kazakhstan's rural schools
case_studies.model: Fellowship placing graduates in underserved schools. Part of Teach For All network.
case_studies.impact: Fellows placed across multiple regions; part of global network
case_studies.what_worked: Adapted global model to Kazakh context; government support
case_studies.what_didnt: Scale limited; post-Soviet educational structures resistant to change
case_studies.key_lesson: Post-Soviet systems need external pressure to reform. Fellowship programs create that pressure.

case_studies.title: Social Innovation Park Kazakhstan
case_studies.problem: Kazakhstan lacks social enterprise ecosystem
case_studies.model: Government-supported innovation hub for social enterprises. Training, funding, mentorship.
case_studies.impact: Supported dozens of social enterprises; policy advocacy
case_studies.what_worked: Government backing provides legitimacy and resources
case_studies.what_didnt: Government dependency; limited private sector engagement
case_studies.key_lesson: In high-PDI countries, government backing is essential. Without it, social enterprise lacks legitimacy.

case_studies.title: Olympiad Education Programs
case_studies.problem: Central Asian students lack access to global educational competitions
case_studies.model: STEM education and competition preparation for talented students in Central Asia.
case_studies.impact: Students competing internationally; STEM talent development
case_studies.what_worked: Merit-based selection; international exposure
case_studies.what_didnt: Benefits elite students; rural access limited
case_studies.key_lesson: Meritocratic programs can exist even in high-PDI systems. They create alternative pathways.

case_studies.title: Aga Khan Foundation in Kyrgyzstan
case_studies.problem: Rural Kyrgyzstan lacks healthcare, education, and economic opportunity
case_studies.model: Integrated development: healthcare, education, economic development, cultural preservation.
case_studies.impact: Programs across multiple oblasts; healthcare improvements; education quality
case_studies.what_worked: Long-term presence; integrated approach; cultural sensitivity
case_studies.what_didnt: Remote areas difficult to reach; funding cycles
case_studies.key_lesson: Integrated development works better than single-sector interventions. Address everything together.

case_studies.title: Innovation and Peace Academy Tajikistan
case_studies.problem: Tajik youth lack critical thinking and innovation skills
case_studies.model: Youth education programs focusing on critical thinking, entrepreneurship, and peace-building.
case_studies.impact: Hundreds of youth trained; peace-building programs
case_studies.what_worked: Addressing both education and peace in post-conflict context
case_studies.what_didnt: Limited reach; government scrutiny of civil society
case_studies.key_lesson: In post-conflict societies, education must include peace-building. They're inseparable.

case_studies.title: Youth Development Programs Turkmenistan
case_studies.problem: Turkmen youth face limited opportunities and restricted civil society
case_studies.model: Government-led youth development with some international NGO support.
case_studies.impact: Limited but growing; some international exchange programs
case_studies.what_worked: Government-led programs reach more youth
case_studies.what_didnt: Civil society space extremely limited; international engagement restricted
case_studies.key_lesson: In the most restrictive environments, even small openings matter. Start with what's allowed.

case_studies.title: Community Health Workers Kyrgyzstan
case_studies.problem: Rural Kyrgyzstan lacks healthcare access; maternal mortality high
case_studies.model: Community health worker program training local women for basic healthcare delivery.
case_studies.impact: Improved maternal and child health indicators in pilot regions
case_studies.what_worked: Local women as health workers; government integration
case_studies.what_didnt: Funding challenges; health worker retention
case_studies.key_lesson: The ASHA model works across cultures. Local women as health workers is universal.

case_studies.title: Microfinance in Central Asia
case_studies.problem: Central Asian poor lack access to financial services
case_studies.model: Microfinance institutions providing small loans to entrepreneurs.
case_studies.impact: Hundreds of thousands of borrowers across Central Asia
case_studies.what_worked: Group lending model adapted to Central Asian context
case_studies.what_didnt: High interest rates; some debt cycles; regulatory challenges
case_studies.key_lesson: Microfinance works in Central Asia, but must be paired with financial literacy.

case_studies.title: Civil Society Development Uzbekistan
case_studies.problem: Uzbekistan's civil society space is extremely restricted
case_studies.model: Gradual civil society development through government-approved channels.
case_studies.impact: Slow but growing; some NGO registration; limited but real
case_studies.what_worked: Working within government-approved channels
case_studies.what_didnt: Space extremely limited; international funding restricted
case_studies.key_lesson: In the most restrictive environments, work within what's allowed. Small openings become big ones over time.

case_studies.title: Nazarbayev Schools
case_studies.problem: Kazakhstan's education system needs modernization
case_studies.model: Elite STEM schools with international standards. Merit-based admission.
case_studies.impact: Top students achieving international standards; STEM talent pipeline
case_studies.what_worked: International standards; merit-based selection; government investment
case_studies.what_didnt: Benefits elite; rural students excluded; creates two-tier system
case_studies.key_lesson: Elite schools create benchmarks. When the best schools prove what's possible, others follow.

mena.hofstede_summary: High PDI (65-80), Low IDV (25-38), Medium MAS, High UAI, Low IVR (20-40)

case_studies.title: Ruwwad: Community-Led Development in Jordan
case_studies.problem: Marginalized communities in Jordan lack education, employment, and voice
case_studies.model: Community-led development: youth empowerment, education, civic engagement, economic development.
case_studies.impact: Thousands of youth empowered; community centers in multiple neighborhoods
case_studies.what_worked: Community-led approach; youth as agents of change
case_studies.what_didnt: Funding dependent; scaling beyond Amman
case_studies.key_lesson: Youth are not the problem — they're the solution. Empower them to lead their own communities.

case_studies.title: Souk el Tayeb: Lebanon's Farmers Market
case_studies.problem: Lebanese small farmers can't access markets; traditional food culture disappearing
case_studies.model: Farmers market connecting small farmers directly to consumers. Promotes traditional food culture.
case_studies.impact: Multiple markets across Lebanon; hundreds of farmers connected to consumers
case_studies.what_worked: Cultural pride as driver; direct farmer-consumer connection
case_studies.what_didnt: Economic crisis in Lebanon; infrastructure damage
case_studies.key_lesson: Food is culture. When you preserve traditional food, you preserve traditional communities.

case_studies.title: Nahdet el Mahrousa: Egypt's Social Enterprise Incubator
case_studies.problem: Egyptian social entrepreneurs lack support and ecosystem
case_studies.model: Incubator for social enterprises. Training, mentorship, funding, policy advocacy.
case_studies.impact: Supported hundreds of social enterprises; ecosystem building in Egypt
case_studies.what_worked: First-mover in Egyptian social enterprise ecosystem
case_studies.what_didnt: Political instability disrupted operations; funding cycles
case_studies.key_lesson: Ecosystem building takes time. Be patient. The first organization creates space for hundreds more.

case_studies.title: INJAZ: Youth Economic Empowerment
case_studies.problem: Middle Eastern youth lack entrepreneurship and employment skills
case_studies.model: JA Worldwide model adapted to MENA. School-based entrepreneurship and financial literacy programs.
case_studies.impact: Millions of students across MENA; corporate partnerships
case_studies.what_worked: Adapted global model to MENA context; corporate partnerships
case_studies.what_didnt: Quality varies by country; government adoption inconsistent
case_studies.key_lesson: Global models work when adapted locally. The JA model works in MENA because it respects cultural context.

case_studies.title: Mobaderoon: Syrian Civil Society in Exile
case_studies.problem: Syrian civil society destroyed by war; activists in exile lack support
case_studies.model: Network supporting Syrian civil society organizations in exile. Training, funding, advocacy.
case_studies.impact: Supported dozens of Syrian CSOs in exile; maintained civil society capacity
case_studies.what_worked: Keeping civil society alive during war; diaspora network
case_studies.what_didnt: Operating in exile is inherently challenging; funding cycles
case_studies.key_lesson: Civil society can survive war. Even in exile, keep the networks alive.

case_studies.title: Caritas Lebanon: Refugee Services
case_studies.problem: Lebanon hosts 1.5M+ Syrian refugees with limited services
case_studies.model: Multi-sector refugee response: healthcare, education, shelter, livelihoods, protection.
case_studies.impact: Hundreds of thousands of refugees served; healthcare and education programs
case_studies.what_worked: Long-term presence; trusted by refugee communities; multi-sector approach
case_studies.what_didnt: Funding cuts; Lebanese economic crisis; refugee fatigue
case_studies.key_lesson: Long-term presence builds trust that emergency organizations can't replicate.

case_studies.title: Tunisia's Social Enterprise Movement
case_studies.problem: Post-Arab Spring Tunisia needs economic alternatives; youth unemployment high
case_studies.model: Social enterprise ecosystem development: incubators, funding, policy advocacy.
case_studies.impact: Growing social enterprise sector; policy reforms; youth engagement
case_studies.what_worked: Post-revolution openness to new models; international support
case_studies.what_didnt: Political instability; economic challenges; brain drain
case_studies.key_lesson: Revolution creates openings. Social enterprise fills the gap between government and market.

case_studies.title: Yemen Humanitarian Response
case_studies.problem: Yemen: world's worst humanitarian crisis. 24M need aid.
case_studies.model: Multi-sector humanitarian response: health, food, water, shelter, protection.
case_studies.impact: Millions served; but crisis continues
case_studies.what_worked: International attention and funding; local partnerships
case_studies.what_didnt: Access constraints; funding shortfalls; conflict continues
case_studies.key_lesson: In the worst crises, the question isn't 'how do we solve this?' but 'how do we keep people alive?'

case_studies.title: Palestine Education Programs
case_studies.problem: Palestinian children face interrupted education due to conflict and displacement
case_studies.model: UNRWA schools and education programs; some innovative approaches to conflict-affected education.
case_studies.impact: Hundreds of thousands of students; some innovative education models
case_studies.what_worked: UNRWA provides consistent education despite conflict
case_studies.what_didnt: Funding crises; access restrictions; conflict damage to schools
case_studies.key_lesson: Education is resistance. Keeping schools open in conflict zones is an act of defiance.

case_studies.title: Egypt Community Health Programs
case_studies.problem: Rural Egypt lacks healthcare access; maternal mortality high in some regions
case_studies.model: Community health worker programs; mobile clinics; telemedicine pilots.
case_studies.impact: Improved health indicators in pilot regions; some scaling
case_studies.what_worked: Community health workers in rural areas; government partnerships
case_studies.what_didnt: Funding; health worker retention; scaling challenges
case_studies.key_lesson: The community health worker model works in Egypt too. Local women, local trust, local health.

east_africa.hofstede_summary: Medium-High PDI, Low IDV (collectivist), Medium MAS, Medium UAI

case_studies.title: Ushahidi: Crisis Mapping in 150 Countries
case_studies.problem: No tool for citizens to report crisis events in real-time
case_studies.model: Open-source crowdsourcing platform. SMS/email/web reports on public maps.
case_studies.impact: Deployed in 150+ countries; Haiti, Syria, Japan deployments
case_studies.what_worked: Open-source enabled global adoption; first-mover in crisis mapping
case_studies.what_didnt: Sustainability challenges; competition from commercial tools
case_studies.key_lesson: A simple tech layer on citizen reporting can replace expensive surveillance infrastructure.

case_studies.title: M-Pesa: Mobile Money That Lifted 194,000 Households
case_studies.problem: Kenyan poor can't access banking; sending money is expensive and dangerous
case_studies.model: Mobile money via SMS/USSD on basic phones. 100,000+ local agents (shopkeepers) as banking network.
case_studies.impact: 194,000 households lifted out of poverty (Suri & Jack, Science 2016); women saved 22% more; remittance costs dropped ~90%
case_studies.what_worked: Leveraged existing trust (shopkeepers); worked on $10 phones; small per-transaction fee
case_studies.what_didnt: Regulatory challenges in other countries; agent liquidity issues
case_studies.key_lesson: 100,000 local agents became the banking network, using trust already embedded in neighborhoods.

case_studies.title: M-KOPA: Pay-As-You-Go Solar
case_studies.problem: 600M+ Africans lack electricity; can't afford upfront solar
case_studies.model: Pay-as-you-go solar via daily M-Pesa micropayments. IoT asset locking.
case_studies.impact: 7M+ customers; KES 207B credit unlocked; 200,000 new customers/month
case_studies.what_worked: Leveraged M-Pesa; daily payments matched daily income; IoT locking reduced defaults
case_studies.what_didnt: Device quality complaints; aggressive collection criticism
case_studies.key_lesson: Match payment to income pattern. Daily workers need daily payments.

case_studies.title: One Acre Fund: $75 Lifts Farmers From Poverty
case_studies.problem: Smallholder farmers can't afford seeds and fertilizer
case_studies.model: $75 loan for bundled seed, fertilizer, 8 training sessions, market access.
case_studies.impact: 4.8M farmers served; ~50% income increase; 9 countries
case_studies.what_worked: Revenue model ensures sustainability; field officer model; bundled service
case_studies.what_didnt: Dependence on donors for expansion; climate risk
case_studies.key_lesson: Bundle the service. Seeds alone fail. Training alone fails. Together, they work.

case_studies.title: KickStart: $180 Pumps Lifted 1.7M From Poverty
case_studies.problem: Rain-dependent farming traps millions in poverty
case_studies.model: Design and sell low-cost irrigation pumps ($180) through local retail.
case_studies.impact: 400,000+ pumps sold; $700+ profit per farmer; 1.7M+ lifted from poverty
case_studies.what_worked: Market-based approach (selling, not donating); local retail distribution
case_studies.what_didnt: Some farmers couldn't sustain irrigation; subsidy debates
case_studies.key_lesson: Sell, don't give. Selling proves value. Donating proves need.

case_studies.title: Living Goods: Smartphones for 12,000 Health Workers
case_studies.problem: Preventable child and maternal deaths in rural Africa
case_studies.model: Train CHWs with smartphones, medicines, diagnostics. Door-to-door care.
case_studies.impact: 12,000+ CHWs serving 6.7M people; 27% under-5 mortality reduction
case_studies.what_worked: Tech-enabled CHW model; government integration; RCT evidence
case_studies.what_didnt: Government adoption varies; donor dependency
case_studies.key_lesson: Don't replace the system — strengthen it. Put smartphones in hands of women already walking door to door.

case_studies.title: Zipline: Drones Deliver Blood in Rwanda
case_studies.problem: Rural hospitals run out of blood, vaccines, medicines
case_studies.model: Autonomous drone delivery. WhatsApp ordering. Parachute drop.
case_studies.impact: 1M+ deliveries; 61% faster blood delivery; 67% fewer blood expirations
case_studies.what_worked: Government partnership with Rwanda; life-saving metrics convinced skeptics
case_studies.what_didnt: High infrastructure costs; regulatory barriers outside Africa
case_studies.key_lesson: When the problem is life-or-death, speed is the product. Find your '61% faster' metric.

case_studies.title: Andela: Africa's Tech Talent Pipeline
case_studies.problem: Africa has brilliant engineers but no pathway to global jobs
case_studies.model: Train developers, connect to global companies. Income-sharing model.
case_studies.impact: 110,000+ developers trained; $1.5B valuation; 135 countries
case_studies.what_worked: Income-sharing model; remote work trend accelerated demand
case_studies.what_didnt: Laid off 400+ junior devs in 2019; pivoted model
case_studies.key_lesson: Genius is evenly distributed. Opportunity is not. Remove the geography, unlock the talent.

case_studies.title: Ethiopia Health Extension Workers
case_studies.problem: Rural Ethiopia lacks healthcare access
case_studies.model: Two female government-salaried workers per rural health post serving ~5,000 people. 16 packages of care.
case_studies.impact: Over 80% of rural posts provide essential services; dramatic improvements in child immunization
case_studies.what_worked: Government-funded (sustainable); local women chosen by community
case_studies.what_didnt: 45.5% job satisfaction; heavy workload; limited referral capacity
case_studies.key_lesson: Local women chosen by their community, living in the village they serve, are the most effective health workers.

case_studies.title: SafeBoda: Safe Motorcycle Taxis in Uganda
case_studies.problem: Motorcycle taxi (boda boda) accidents are a leading cause of death and injury in East Africa
case_studies.model: Trained, helmet-equipped motorcycle taxi drivers with an app. Safety standards + technology.
case_studies.impact: Thousands of trained drivers; reduced accident rates; expanded to Nigeria
case_studies.what_worked: Safety as differentiator; technology + training; rider community
case_studies.what_didnt: Competition from untrained drivers; regulatory challenges
case_studies.key_lesson: Safety is a product. When you make motorcycle taxis safe, customers choose safety.

west_africa.hofstede_summary: High PDI (70-80), Low-Medium IDV, Medium MAS, High IVR in Nigeria (84)

case_studies.title: Flutterwave: Africa's Payment Rails
case_studies.problem: Fragmented payment infrastructure across Africa
case_studies.model: Unified payment API enabling businesses to accept payments across 34+ countries.
case_studies.impact: 200M+ transactions; $3B valuation; 1M+ merchants; 34+ countries
case_studies.what_worked: First-mover on cross-border African payments; strong enterprise client base
case_studies.what_didnt: Regulatory challenges; governance scrutiny
case_studies.key_lesson: Build the rails, not the train. Infrastructure enables everything else.

case_studies.title: Andela Nigeria
case_studies.problem: Nigeria's tech talent lacks pathway to global jobs
case_studies.model: Train developers, connect to global companies. Income-sharing model.
case_studies.impact: 110,000+ developers trained across Africa; significant Nigeria presence
case_studies.what_worked: Nigeria as largest talent pool; income-sharing model
case_studies.what_didnt: Academy model unsustainable; pivoted to marketplace
case_studies.key_lesson: Nigeria's talent is world-class. The barrier is access, not ability.

case_studies.title: LifeBank: Blood Delivered in Under 1 Hour
case_studies.problem: Maternal deaths from blood shortages
case_studies.model: Platform connecting blood banks to hospitals. Motorcycle and drone delivery.
case_studies.impact: 3,500+ lives saved; 30,000+ blood deliveries; 700+ hospitals
case_studies.what_worked: Data-driven logistics; started motorcycles, added drones; founder's personal story
case_studies.what_didnt: Cold chain challenges; scaling beyond Lagos capital-intensive
case_studies.key_lesson: The founder's story IS the pitch. Personal pain creates authentic purpose.

case_studies.title: Farmcrowdy: Crowdfunding Nigerian Farms
case_studies.problem: 38M smallholder farmers lack capital and markets
case_studies.model: Digital platform connecting investors with farmers. Investors fund farm cycles.
case_studies.impact: 500,000+ farmers enabled; 40% yield increase
case_studies.what_worked: Crowdfunding attracted urban Nigerians; AI-powered insights
case_studies.what_didnt: Pivoted from crowdfunding to B2B; farmer repayment challenges
case_studies.key_lesson: Connect the city to the farm. Urban investors fund rural farmers. Both benefit.

case_studies.title: Piggyvest: 6 Million Nigerians Saving
case_studies.problem: Only 2% of Nigerians save formally
case_studies.model: Automated savings platform with lock features, goal-based savings.
case_studies.impact: 6M+ users; NGN 1.3T in payouts (2025); 76% AUM growth
case_studies.what_worked: Gamified savings with social proof; annual report became cultural phenomenon
case_studies.what_didnt: Regulatory uncertainty; customer support scaling
case_studies.key_lesson: Make saving social. When everyone shares their savings report, saving becomes a status symbol.

case_studies.title: Moniepoint: Banking Nigeria's Informal Economy
case_studies.problem: 60M+ informal businesses lack digital payments
case_studies.model: Agent banking: POS terminals, business accounts, lending to informal merchants.
case_studies.impact: NGN 412T processed; 6M+ merchants; $1.1B valuation; profitable unicorn
case_studies.what_worked: Focused on overlooked informal market; hardware + software bundle
case_studies.what_didnt: Agent fraud; rising compliance costs
case_studies.key_lesson: The informal market is the market. 60M businesses that banks ignored are now Moniepoint's customers.

case_studies.title: CcHUB: Africa's Largest Innovation Hub
case_studies.problem: Nigeria's tech ecosystem lacked collaboration space
case_studies.model: Innovation hub: co-working, accelerators, venture building.
case_studies.impact: Work in 49 countries; 72 edtech startups; incubated BudgIT, LifeBank
case_studies.what_worked: Gravitational center of Lagos tech ecosystem; government partnerships
case_studies.what_didnt: Dependent on grants; impact measurement challenges
case_studies.key_lesson: Be the gravity. When the ecosystem orbits around you, everything grows.

case_studies.title: Tony Elumelu Foundation: $100M for 24,000 Entrepreneurs
case_studies.problem: Africa's entrepreneurs lack seed capital, mentorship
case_studies.model: $5,000 seed capital + 12-week training + mentorship. Non-refundable grant.
case_studies.impact: 24,000+ entrepreneurs; $100M+ seed capital; 5M+ jobs; $4.2B revenue
case_studies.what_worked: Non-refundable grant — no repayment pressure; pan-African scope; 68% women in 2025
case_studies.what_didnt: $5,000 insufficient for capital-intensive sectors
case_studies.key_lesson: Non-refundable grants remove the fear of failure. When you don't have to pay it back, you take bigger risks.

case_studies.title: Esoko: Market Prices for Ghanaian Farmers
case_studies.problem: Ghanaian farmers don't know market prices; exploited by middlemen
case_studies.model: SMS-based market price information service for farmers. Also provides agronomic tips and weather alerts.
case_studies.impact: Hundreds of thousands of farmers receiving market prices; expanded across West Africa
case_studies.what_worked: SMS delivery works on basic phones; farmers earn more with price information
case_studies.what_didnt: Subscription fees limit adoption among poorest; data quality varies
case_studies.key_lesson: Information is power. When farmers know the price, they negotiate better.

case_studies.title: Farmerline: Voice Messages for Ghanaian Farmers
case_studies.problem: Ghanaian farmers lack access to agricultural information in local languages
case_studies.model: Voice-based agricultural information service in local languages. Weather, market prices, farming tips.
case_studies.impact: Hundreds of thousands of farmers reached; voice messages in multiple local languages
case_studies.what_worked: Voice delivery works for illiterate farmers; local language support
case_studies.what_didnt: Connectivity challenges in remote areas; scaling
case_studies.key_lesson: Voice is the interface for the illiterate. Not everyone can read. Everyone can listen.

central_south_africa.hofstede_summary: High PDI (75-85), Very Low IDV, Medium-High MAS, Very Low IVR (15-20)

case_studies.title: Panzi Hospital: 30,000 Survivors Treated
case_studies.problem: Sexual violence as weapon of war in eastern DRC
case_studies.model: Holistic 'one-stop center': medical, psychosocial, legal, reintegration.
case_studies.impact: 30,000+ survivors treated; Nobel Peace Prize 2018
case_studies.what_worked: Holistic one-stop model became global reference; Nobel Prize elevated the issue
case_studies.what_didnt: Chronic underfunding; security threats; can't scale beyond South Kivu
case_studies.key_lesson: Medical care alone isn't enough. Survivors need legal, psychological, and community support together.

case_studies.title: HEAL Africa: Teaching Hospital in War-Torn Goma
case_studies.problem: Medical and social needs in war-torn eastern DRC
case_studies.model: Community hospital providing surgical care, psychosocial support, community development.
case_studies.impact: Premier teaching hospital in Goma; thousands treated; PHR partnership
case_studies.what_worked: Integrated medical-social approach; local ownership; 20 years of trust
case_studies.what_didnt: Repeated displacement due to conflict; donor dependency
case_studies.key_lesson: Local ownership creates trust that no outside organization can replicate.

case_studies.title: Eastern Congo Initiative
case_studies.problem: Lack of international attention and funding for eastern Congo
case_studies.model: Grant-making initiative funding local Congolese organizations rather than implementing directly.
case_studies.impact: 15+ years of partnerships; local-led approach
case_studies.what_worked: Celebrity advocacy brought Congressional attention; grant-making empowers locals
case_studies.what_didnt: Celebrity-driven sustainability questions; small scale vs. crisis
case_studies.key_lesson: Fund the locals, don't replace them. They know the context better than any outsider.

case_studies.title: Women for Women International DRC
case_studies.problem: Extreme gender inequality and sexual violence in conflict zones
case_studies.model: 12-month program: rights awareness, vocational skills, business training, peer support.
case_studies.impact: RCT published 2020 showed significant increases in savings, assets, empowerment
case_studies.what_worked: Rigorous evidence base (RCT); holistic approach
case_studies.what_didnt: Scaling in active conflict; sustainability after program
case_studies.key_lesson: RCT evidence is the most powerful fundraising tool. Prove it works with data.

case_studies.title: Harambee: Youth Employment in South Africa
case_studies.problem: South Africa has 60%+ youth unemployment
case_studies.model: Connects unemployed youth with entry-level jobs. Provides work-readiness training, matching, and post-placement support.
case_studies.impact: Hundreds of thousands of youth connected to employment; partnerships with major employers
case_studies.what_worked: Work-readiness training bridges the gap; employer partnerships ensure demand
case_studies.what_didnt: Entry-level jobs are low-wage; structural unemployment persists
case_studies.key_lesson: The gap between unemployed youth and unfilled jobs is a matching problem, not a supply problem.

case_studies.title: Equal Education: School Quality in South Africa
case_studies.problem: South African schools in poor communities lack quality; apartheid legacy persists
case_studies.model: Evidence-based advocacy for school quality. Research, campaigns, legal action.
case_studies.impact: Policy changes; school infrastructure improvements; national movement
case_studies.what_worked: Evidence-based approach; youth-led movement; legal strategy
case_studies.what_didnt: Slow progress; government resistance in some provinces
case_studies.key_lesson: Evidence + activism = policy change. Data alone doesn't change policy. Activism alone lacks credibility.

case_studies.title: Ikamva Youth: Township Education Support
case_studies.problem: South African township students lack academic support and career guidance
case_studies.model: After-school tutoring and career guidance by volunteer university students. Peer-to-peer model.
case_studies.impact: Thousands of students supported; high university admission rates; model replicated
case_studies.what_worked: Peer tutoring — university students teach township students; volunteer model
case_studies.what_didnt: Scaling challenges; volunteer retention
case_studies.key_lesson: Peer tutoring works. University students teaching township students creates a pipeline both ways.

case_studies.title: Shack Dwellers Federation of South Africa
case_studies.organization: Federation of the Urban and Rural Poor
case_studies.problem: Millions of South Africans live in informal settlements
case_studies.model: Community-led housing: savings groups, incremental building, land negotiation with government.
case_studies.impact: Thousands of houses built; savings groups across South Africa; policy influence
case_studies.what_worked: Community savings as foundation; incremental building; government negotiation
case_studies.what_didnt: Slow to scale; government partnership inconsistent
case_studies.key_lesson: Community savings builds ownership. When people save for their own house, they build it to last.

case_studies.title: Mozambique Community Health Workers
case_studies.problem: Mozambique has one of the world's lowest doctor-to-patient ratios
case_studies.model: Community health workers (agentes polivalentes elementares) providing basic healthcare in rural areas.
case_studies.impact: Improved health indicators in rural areas; reduced maternal and child mortality
case_studies.what_worked: Government-funded; local workers; integrated into health system
case_studies.what_didnt: Training quality varies; health worker motivation; supply chain challenges
case_studies.key_lesson: The community health worker model works in the most resource-constrained settings.

case_studies.title: Malaria Consortium: Seasonal Malaria Chemoprevention
case_studies.problem: Malaria kills 600,000+ people annually, mostly children under 5 in West/Central Africa
case_studies.model: Seasonal malaria chemoprevention (SMC): monthly preventive medication during rainy season for children 3-59 months.
case_studies.impact: Millions of children treated; GiveWell top charity; significant malaria reduction
case_studies.what_worked: Preventive approach (not treatment); seasonal timing; community health workers
case_studies.what_didnt: Drug resistance concerns; logistics in remote areas; funding cycles
case_studies.key_lesson: Prevention is cheaper than treatment. Monthly pills during rainy season prevent malaria.

case_studies.title: Instituto Ayrton Senna: 36 Million Students
case_studies.problem: Brazil's education system fails millions of children
case_studies.model: Partners with public school systems for teacher training, curriculum, policy advocacy.
case_studies.impact: 36 million students; 3,000+ cities; 70,000+ teachers trained annually
case_studies.what_worked: Massive scale through public-private partnerships; data-driven; Senna brand
case_studies.what_didnt: Education outcomes still poor despite scale; systemic issues require government action
case_studies.key_lesson: Legacy can scale. One person's story, properly channeled, can reach 36 million students.

case_studies.title: Gerando Falcoes: Tech-Enabled Favela Development
case_studies.problem: Intergenerational poverty in Brazil's favelas (16M+ people)
case_studies.model: Tech-enabled community development: education, employment, 'Smart Slums' infrastructure.
case_studies.impact: 232 communities; 100,000+ families; largest crowdfunded Brazilian NGO
case_studies.what_worked: Founder's authentic favela background; tech-forward approach attracts private sector
case_studies.what_didnt: Scalability of intensive interventions; fundraising dependency
case_studies.key_lesson: Authenticity is the ultimate trust signal. Growing up in the favela gives credibility no outsider can buy.

case_studies.title: Gastromotiva: Social Gastronomy Movement
case_studies.problem: Youth unemployment and food insecurity in favelas
case_studies.model: Professional culinary training for vulnerable youth. Community kitchens. Solidary Kitchens.
case_studies.impact: ~600 youth trained annually; 100,000+ families reached; Ashoka Globalizer
case_studies.what_worked: Gastronomy as accessible entry point for social mobility; Rio 2016 Olympics project
case_studies.what_didnt: Culinary training alone doesn't address structural unemployment
case_studies.key_lesson: Food is the universal language. Everyone eats. Use gastronomy as the entry point for social change.

case_studies.title: Instituto Sou da Paz: Evidence-Based Violence Prevention
case_studies.problem: Brazil's epidemic: ~50,000 homicides annually
case_studies.model: Evidence-based violence prevention: arms control advocacy, community policing reform.
case_studies.impact: 25+ years; contributed to arms control legislation
case_studies.what_worked: Evidence-based approach built credibility with policymakers
case_studies.what_didnt: Violence rates remain high; political shifts reverse gains
case_studies.key_lesson: Evidence beats ideology. When you show the data, policymakers listen.

case_studies.title: Laboratoria: Coding Bootcamp for Low-Income Women
case_studies.problem: Gender gap in tech; women from low-income backgrounds excluded
case_studies.model: Intensive 6-month coding bootcamp. Job placement support. Employer partnerships.
case_studies.impact: Thousands of women trained; 80%+ placement rate; expanded to Mexico, Chile, Brazil, Colombia
case_studies.what_worked: High placement rates prove the model; employer partnerships ensure hiring
case_studies.what_didnt: Intensive model limits throughput; tech industry gender bias persists
case_studies.key_lesson: Placement rate is the metric that matters. 80%+ placement proves the training works.

case_studies.title: Konfio: AI Credit Scoring for Mexican SMEs
case_studies.problem: ~50% of Mexican adults unbanked; SMEs rejected by banks
case_studies.model: Fintech platform using alternative data and AI for credit scoring.
case_studies.impact: Hundreds of thousands of SMEs served; $200M+ raised including SoftBank
case_studies.what_worked: Technology-driven underwriting; served previously 'unbankable' businesses
case_studies.what_didnt: High interest rates; regulatory uncertainty
case_studies.key_lesson: The 'unbankable' are bankable — you just need better data to see it.

case_studies.title: Kueski: BNPL for Mexico's Unbanked
case_studies.problem: Majority of Mexicans lack access to traditional consumer credit
case_studies.model: Consumer lending + 'Kueski Pay' BNPL for e-commerce. Alternative credit scoring via mobile data.
case_studies.impact: Millions of users; BNPL pioneer in Mexico
case_studies.what_worked: BNPL matched e-commerce growth; mobile-first approach
case_studies.what_didnt: Consumer debt risks; high default rates in downturns
case_studies.key_lesson: Match the payment method to the shopping method. E-commerce needs e-payments.

case_studies.title: TECHO: Youth-Led Housing in Latin America
case_studies.problem: Millions in Latin America live in informal settlements
case_studies.model: Youth volunteers build emergency housing alongside families. Long-term community development.
case_studies.impact: Hundreds of thousands of houses built across 19 countries; millions of volunteer hours
case_studies.what_worked: Youth engagement as driver; emergency housing + long-term development
case_studies.what_didnt: Emergency housing is temporary; systemic poverty persists
case_studies.key_lesson: Youth volunteers build more than houses — they build empathy. The volunteer changes as much as the family.

case_studies.title: Fundacion Lasagna: Education in Colombian Conflict Zones
case_studies.problem: Colombian children in conflict zones lack access to quality education
case_studies.model: Mobile education programs reaching children in conflict-affected areas. Trauma-informed teaching.
case_studies.impact: Thousands of children reached in conflict zones; innovative education models
case_studies.what_worked: Mobile approach reaches children where they are; trauma-informed methods
case_studies.what_didnt: Conflict access challenges; funding cycles
case_studies.key_lesson: In conflict zones, the school must come to the child, not the child to the school.

case_studies.title: Comedores Populares: Community Kitchens in Peru
case_studies.problem: Peruvian urban poor lack access to affordable nutritious food
case_studies.model: Community-run kitchens where neighbors pool resources and cook together. Self-managed, self-funded.
case_studies.impact: Thousands of comedores across Peru; millions of meals served; model replicated across Latin America
case_studies.what_worked: Community self-management; pooled resources; women-led
case_studies.what_didnt: Quality varies; some dependency on government subsidies
case_studies.key_lesson: Community kitchens are more than food — they're social infrastructure. Women-led, community-owned.

case_studies.title: Kiron: Free University for Refugees
case_studies.problem: Refugees excluded from higher education
case_studies.model: Free online degree pathways partnering with universities.
case_studies.impact: 175,000+ learners from 160 nationalities; 4,000+ healthcare workers trained
case_studies.what_worked: Transition from NGO to social business with employer-funded programs
case_studies.what_didnt: Early grant dependence; pivot required by 2023
case_studies.key_lesson: Refugees aren't just beneficiaries — they're talent. Train them, employ them, transform them.

case_studies.title: Sozialhelden: 3.2M Venue Entries for Accessibility
case_studies.problem: Urban inaccessibility for wheelchair users
case_studies.model: Crowdsourced platform (Wheelmap.org) + disability consulting.
case_studies.impact: 3.2M+ venue entries worldwide; consulting for major companies
case_studies.what_worked: Open-data approach scaled globally without heavy infrastructure
case_studies.what_didnt: Crowdsourced data quality varies by region
case_studies.key_lesson: Crowdsourcing turns users into builders. The community builds the product for you.

case_studies.title: BonVenture: Impact VC in DACH Region
case_studies.problem: Social enterprises lack access to venture capital
case_studies.model: Impact venture capital fund across DACH region.
case_studies.impact: 60+ investments; 7.4M lives touched; 650,000 tonnes CO2 saved; EUR 100M AUM
case_studies.what_worked: Blended 'true impact and return' model attracted mainstream investors
case_studies.what_didnt: Smaller deal sizes vs. traditional VC
case_studies.key_lesson: Impact and return aren't opposites. Prove both, and mainstream investors will follow.

case_studies.title: Teach First Deutschland
case_studies.problem: Educational inequality at under-resourced schools
case_studies.model: Two-year fellowships placing top graduates at Brennpunktschulen.
case_studies.impact: 500+ alumni network; Teach For All global network
case_studies.what_worked: Corporate partnerships provided sustainable funding
case_studies.what_didnt: Fellows leave after two years — continuity gaps
case_studies.key_lesson: Two years is enough to change a child's trajectory. Even temporary excellence matters.

case_studies.title: Viva con Agua: Water Through Music and Football
case_studies.organization: Viva con Agua de Sankt Pauli
case_studies.problem: 696M people lack safe drinking water
case_studies.model: Festival/event-based fundraising + WASH project delivery. From FC St. Pauli fan community.
case_studies.impact: Raised millions through events; projects in multiple countries
case_studies.what_worked: Culture-first approach attracted demographics traditional NGOs miss
case_studies.what_didnt: Event revenue is volatile
case_studies.key_lesson: Meet people where they are. If they're at a concert, make the concert the fundraiser.

case_studies.title: betterplace.org: Germany's Largest Donation Platform
case_studies.problem: Donor trust gap and fragmented charitable giving
case_studies.model: Germany's largest donation platform connecting donors directly to verified projects.
case_studies.impact: Thousands of projects; millions in donations processed
case_studies.what_worked: Transparency model built trust
case_studies.what_didnt: Platform fees create tension with smaller NPOs
case_studies.key_lesson: Transparency is a feature, not a nice-to-have. Show donors exactly where their money goes.

case_studies.title: Ashoka Germany
case_studies.problem: Social entrepreneurs lack systemic support
case_studies.model: Fellowship funding + McKinsey-partnered scaling programs.
case_studies.impact: McKinsey 2019: EUR 18B potential from Ashoka's German network; 3,800+ fellows globally
case_studies.what_worked: Ashoka Globalizer program scales system-change entrepreneurs
case_studies.what_didnt: Selection process highly competitive, limiting reach
case_studies.key_lesson: Ecosystem building creates multiplier effects. One supported entrepreneur creates space for hundreds.

case_studies.title: Grameen Creative Lab: Social Business Design
case_studies.problem: Social business concept lacks institutional adoption
case_studies.model: Consulting + social business design with corporations (BNP Paribas partnership).
case_studies.impact: Social business frameworks adopted by major corporations; evolved into Yunus Environment Hub
case_studies.what_worked: Yunus's Nobel Prize credibility opened corporate doors
case_studies.what_didnt: Concept remained niche in German corporate culture
case_studies.key_lesson: Nobel Prize credibility opens doors. Use your credibility to create institutional adoption.

case_studies.title: SEND: Social Entrepreneurship Network Deutschland
case_studies.problem: Social entrepreneurship lacks political framework in Germany
case_studies.model: Advocacy network + Social Impact Fonds. Connects social enterprises with policy makers.
case_studies.impact: Advocates for enabling legislation; connects practitioners with government
case_studies.what_worked: Bridging gap between practitioners and government
case_studies.what_didnt: Policy change in Germany is slow; legal forms for social enterprises limited
case_studies.key_lesson: Policy change is slow but permanent. Keep advocating. The framework you build today enables thousands tomorrow.

case_studies.title: Impact Hub: Global Social Enterprise Network
case_studies.problem: Social entrepreneurs lack workspace, community, and acceleration
case_studies.model: Coworking + incubation programs + ecosystem building. 100+ cities globally.
case_studies.impact: 16,000+ members globally; hundreds of organizations supported
case_studies.what_worked: Physical community creates network effects; global network
case_studies.what_didnt: Membership costs can exclude early-stage founders
case_studies.key_lesson: Physical community creates trust that digital can't replicate. Co-working is co-creating.
